Package com.csse3200.game.win

Class QuestLedger

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.win.QuestLedger
public final class QuestLedger extends Object
A running count of the quests the player has COMPLETED, by kind. The quest system today only remembers quests that are still active (and the running totals of jumps, kills, gold spent and shields collected); once a quest is turned in it is cleared and forgotten. The win scale needs "how many quests were finished", so this class remembers that.

Kinds match the four quest types already in Quests/: JUMP, ENEMIES_KILLED, GOLD_SPENT and SHIELDS_COLLECTED.

Who writes to it: only QuestGiverComponent, at the moment a quest is turned in with a progress of 100 or more (see 06_wiring.md). A quest that is cleared at less than 100 is abandoned and must NOT be recorded.

Saving: the state is static, like Quest and EnemyRegistry. It must be loaded from the save file when a game is loaded and reset when a new game starts, otherwise completed quests would leak between runs.

Limitations: it counts completions, not distinct quests, so the same kind completed twice counts twice. It does not know how many quests the game offers; that is WinEvaluator.QUESTS_REQUIRED_FOR_LEGEND's job. At the time of writing no NPC on the enemies branch hands out quests, so the count stays at zero until team 2's NPCs are merged.

Style reference: EnemyRegistry (static state with load and export).
